## 席位核对 · PR #27120 ← #27052 · epic PM `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` · 2026-10-28T09:02Z

Verdict: **REWORK (patch round on this PR, same claim)** — not governed (0 of 26 paths), +1733 / −167. The first cloud-dispatched card of this epic; the branch, the draft PR and its body are what the dispatch asked for; the session also read its own CI and fixed the one red without a poke.

What the seat read and accepts as built (head `3288364286`):
- `workspacePreference.ts`: one store keyed preference × scope, versioned record, `useSyncExternalStore` read, cross-tab `storage`, SSR / blocked-storage fallback; `recordOpenPreference.ts` is a thin alias with its key and bare spelling unchanged (#27031's tests pass unchanged — acceptance 3).
- `recordPageColumns.ts`: `recordPageColumnDefaults` + `recordTimelineDefaultReason` as one pure function with a row per branch; `recordPageArrangementFor(tier, switches)` is the tier's input, so a column that is off is not drawn and the rest re-flow; `?tab=` untouched, authored `kind: full` never reaches it.
- `panel-toggles.tsx` in `@object-ui/components`; drawn on the crumb row only in a column tier, not embedded; the body states the merge order with #27038 (now on `main`: ↑ ↓ · divider · toggles).
- Screenshots on the evidence branch `claude/issue-27052-evidence` (`crm_contact` both columns / timeline off / tooltip, `crm_product` default two columns) — accepted; `crm_lead` carries an authored `kind: full` page, so the contact stands in for the worked object.

The one red on head `3288364286` — `RecordDetailView.recordPageTiers-26678` finding two buttons named /Related/ once the 「关联」 panel toggle joined the rail toggle on the row (job 122675293423) — the cloud session fixed on its own at `b36136e279`: the switch is named `detail.relatedColumn` (「关联列」) in all ten packs, and the #26678 pin now finds the rail toggle by `data-testid`, tighter than the name query, not looser. Accepted on reading; not yet measured by CI: that push came through the Claude GitHub App (committer `claude`) and GitHub created no workflow run for it — the commit carries five queued third-party check suites and no `github-actions` suite at all, while `pr-body-guards` listens to `synchronize`. On this repository the App's pushes do not fire the PR workflows; only the PR-open event (the fleet bot's `pr_create`) did. The patch round's push, made with a user token, is what puts the final head under CI. What remains is the two open questions, both answered below and both needing code.

Rulings on the two open questions (seat, within the card's own text; no product semantics beyond it):
1. **`master_detail`-parent branch: B — drop it.** The card's own reading lists campaign, price book, event and knowledge article as OFF; the branch alone turns them ON. A parent that merely owns child rows is a container, not a worked record (ruling 2 on the card), and the rule shrinks to two declared signals (stage kinds, files). Update the derivation, its per-branch test and the HotCRM table in the body.
2. **Chords: B — not browser-reserved.** `⌘⇧T` / `Ctrl+Shift+T` reopens the closed tab and `⌘⇧R` / `Ctrl+Shift+R` hard-reloads in Chromium and Firefox; the page never receives them. Use `⌘⇧.` (timeline) and `⌘⇧,` (related) — `Ctrl+Shift+.` / `Ctrl+Shift+,` elsewhere — unless a real-browser measurement on the branch finds them taken too, in which case choose another unreserved pair and say which was measured. Update the tooltip keycaps, the shortcuts dialog entries and the i18n strings that name the chord.

Patch round (one stroke, same branch):
1. Rulings 1 and 2 above: the derivation drops its `master_detail`-parent branch (per-branch test row and the HotCRM table in the body follow), and the chords move to the unreserved pair (tooltip keycaps, shortcuts dialog entries, i18n strings that name the chord, the `RecordDetailView.panelToggles-27052` chord case).
2. Rerun the derived gates on the final head and the suites the body names; reverse-verify the derivation change (restore the branch, see the campaign / price book / event / article rows red, restore).
3. Report as a comment on #27052 (first line `os-dev-report`), round `patch round 1`.

Report (card comment 6464041380) read and accepted: premise holds; 34 / 34 gates exit 0 on `b36136e2` with the `--ran` reconciliation quoted; ablation of the typing-target guard went red on exactly the chord case and restored to the HEAD blob; the drawer width's `ov:` key is NOT routed through the store (the read and write live in `navigation-overlay.tsx` in `@object-ui/components`, which cannot import an app-shell store) — accepted as an Acceptance note and carried to the layout card #27055, not this patch round; the record-open preference keeps its bare bytes (its tests pin them) — accepted. Seat edits owed on the body at close-out: `detail.relatedColumn` in the i18n bullet and the PanelToggles bullet; the HotCRM table after ruling 1; the chords after ruling 2. Out-of-scope finding carried to the epic parent: HotCRM's lead / account / opportunity / case declare authored `kind: full` pages, so the column tiers and these toggles never reach its most-worked objects until those pages migrate.

Deviations recorded: the cloud session ran on Fable for its first minutes until the maintainer switched it to opus (the desktop launch cannot set the model); the cloud session cannot receive this review, so the patch round runs as a local os-dev agent on the same branch under the same claim.

## 席位核对 · PR #27120 ← #27052 · epic PM `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` · 2026-10-28T10:24Z

Verdict: **ACCEPT** — ordinary queue landing (governed register: 0 of 27 paths; `packages/spec` untouched; +1786 / −167, under the 3000-line threshold). Supersedes the REWORK above: the cloud session's build plus one local patch round, both under the same claim.

Checklist, judged on GitHub and on the branch:
- Shape: draft → `main`; first line `Fixes #27052`; one closing keyword; `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial in the body and in `.changeset/27052-workspace-preferences.md`. No `content/docs/releases/`.
- Scope: 27 files on the claim's surface plus the named consequences: the #26678 tier fixture now declares lifecycle kinds (so it stays a worked object for the reason the narrowed derivation reads), and the `detail.relatedColumn` key that separates the panel switch from the rail toggle. `navigation-overlay.tsx` / `recordDrawerStack.tsx` untouched; the `ov:` drawer-width key stays outside the store (components cannot import an app-shell store) — carried to #27055 as an Acceptance note.
- Rulings landed (patch round 1, report comment 6466430387): the `master_detail`-parent branch is gone and `recordTimelineDefaultReason` / `recordPageColumnDefaults` read only the object (HotCRM `f660fd8`: 8 ON / 12 OFF, the card's expected list exactly); the chords are `⌘⇧.` / `⌘⇧,` matched by physical key, the browser-reserved `⌘⇧T` / `⌘⇧R` now inert. Real-browser delivery of the new chords is NOT MEASURED on this host (Playwright and devtools inject below the accelerator layer); the seat will read it on the console preview after landing.
- Spot checks (seat readings): `workspacePreference.ts` one store, versioned record, `useSyncExternalStore`, `storage` sync, blocked-storage fallback; `recordOpenPreference.ts` a thin alias with its key and bare bytes unchanged (#27031's suites green); `recordPageArrangementFor(tier, switches)` is the tier's second input, nothing hidden at the render site; `PanelToggles` drawn only in a column tier, not embedded; the crumb-row merge keeps #26679's return link on the right beside the toggles.
- Tests and gates: 634 files / 6348 tests on the patch head; plugin-detail + app-shell type-check with their test tsconfigs exit 0; 34 / 34 derived gates with the `--ran` reconciliation (the `vitest run scripts/` red is the macOS host gap plus load timeouts, CI's Lint UI green); reverse verification: the typing-target guard (cloud round) and the restored `master_detail` branch + the old caller (patch round), each red on exactly the pin that reads it and restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty. Pinned to head `fd0f941f70`: 43 success, 11 skipped, 0 other. Verify lock UNLOCKED on the local round (disclosed).
- Screenshots: evidence branch `claude/issue-27052-evidence` @ `3280367b` (contact both columns / timeline off / tooltip; product default two columns) — read by the seat; taken before ruling 2, so the tooltip shows the old chord.
- Acceptance notes (five in the body) agreed; two carried: the `ov:` drawer-width read → #27055; HotCRM's lead / account / opportunity / case carry authored `kind: full` pages so the toggles never reach them → epic parent (a hotcrm follow-up after the layout lands). No cards filed.
- Deviations recorded: the cloud session ran on Fable until the maintainer switched it to opus; its pushes (Claude GitHub App) fired no PR workflow, so the patch round's user-token pushes put the final head under CI; the cloud session read its own CI red and fixed the related-switch name without a poke; dispatch-gates paths taken from the merge base per os-dev.md; body edited by the seat in one PATCH (rulings, `detail.relatedColumn`, HotCRM table, chords, resolved questions, verification head).

Landing: ready + auto-merge in this stroke on the maintainer's standing authorization for this epic (verbatim, 2026-10-28: 「授权你用车队身份给 #26758 翻 ready 并挂 auto-merge（squash），后续本 epic 的 PR 复核 ACCEPT 后同样处理」); the queue decides the rest.
